summaries.body:
ASVS 5.0.0 V12.3.3 is new in the release. The official mapping marks it ADDED and covering 4.0.3 V1.9.1, which required the application to encrypt communications between components, particularly when those components are in different containers, systems, sites, or cloud providers (C3). The current clause is specifically TLS or another appropriate transport encryption for internal HTTP-based services, with no insecure fallback.

The mapping notes that predecessor text is dissimilar and that git/content lineage diverges from the ID slot. On 2019-02-24 tghosth applied C3 changes to V1.9.1. Git on V12.3.3 itself is the old Files RFI/SSRF discussion (#798) and other chapters. Mapping and V1.9.1 are the reliable origin; the git timeline is noisy.

V1.9.1 was an architecture-level encrypt-between-components control. The 5.0 text is narrower: internal HTTP-based services, TLS or another appropriate mechanism, no fallback. The mapping disagrees with git; mapping and predecessor text are authoritative. Issue #798 (RFI/SSRF filename metadata) did not rewrite this communications clause.
